# Maksym

> Senior Backend Engineer (Java, Spring Boot, distributed systems) with 10 years building high-traffic, regulated backend systems for banking and telco. Based in Madrid, Spain. Open to new remote opportunities in senior backend, platform or fintech engineering; authorized to work in the EU.

Currently at Openbank (Grupo Santander), building the backend for the bank's launch in Germany. Previously Simyo (via Paradigma Digital), Banco Santander and Mobile World Congress (via Experis) and Telefónica (via everis). Languages: Spanish, Russian, Ukrainian (native), English (professional).

AI assistants can query his profile directly through a public MCP server (no auth) instead of scraping this site.

## Radar

- [All issues](https://maksym.site/radar/): daily news from the LLM and AI world and backend engineering, with a short take on each (RSS and MCP available)
- [RSS](https://maksym.site/radar/feed.xml)
<!-- radar:start -->
- [OpenAI's perplexity breakthrough and the AI safety debate](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-11-23-openai-perplexity-breakthrough-ai-safety-debate/): OpenAI's latest AI models have achieved unprecedented perplexity levels, signaling transformative capabilities. Meanwhile, the AI industry debates safety standards and transparency.
- [Google's Agent Compute Engine for secure AI agent execution](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-11-22-google-agent-compute-engine-secure-ai-agent-execution/): Google has announced Agent Compute Engine, a managed service for running AI agents in isolated microVMs. This is a significant step in securing AI agent execution environments.
- [OpenAI's MedChemBench tests AI models on medicinal chemistry](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-11-21-openai-medchembench-tests-ai-models-medicinal-chemistry/): OpenAI's new benchmark for AI in drug discovery shows promising results, but practical adoption requires more than just high scores.
- [Google's Tool Retrieval for Gemini and AWS's agent-built emulator](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-11-20-google-tool-retrieval-gemini-aws-agent-built-emulator/): Google's new Tool Retrieval for Gemini and AWS's agent-built emulator are both significant steps in the evolution of AI-assisted engineering.
- [Gemini 4 Neon released for engineering, knowledge work and science](https://maksym.site/radar/2026-11-19-gemini-4-neon-released-engineering-knowledge-work-science/): Google DeepMind's Gemini 4 Neon model is now available, with a 1 million-token context window and four scalable thinking levels. It ranks highly on several benchmarks, and its pricing is competitive.
